name: turns
description: Whose turn it is: players take turns, one after the other, and what belongs to whom. A board game, a card game, a tactics game, a party game passed from hand to hand.

components.name: Turn
components.description: The turn of a game: players is how many take turns, current whose turn it is (0 for the first), number how many turns have been played since the start (it grows by one at each change, and is what a rule that looks at the turn before this one compares with). When the action end_action is pressed the turn goes to the next player, back to the first after the last, and changed_action is raised (none for no action). If several entities have a Turn the oldest one counts.

components.name: Team
components.description: Which player an entity belongs to (0 is the first): a piece, a card, a unit. Other modules read it to know whose it is, and the turn says when it may act.

systems.name: advance
systems.description: Passes the turn to the next player when the end action is pressed.
